judgment.reason: Report.json was created with required structure and both cases solved, but the model has substantive correctness gaps: reserve cost was assumed as 10% of energy cost (unsupported default), quadratic costs were linearized/ignored, and the reference-bus LMP was approximated as lmps[1]. Validation only checked plausibility ranges, not correctness. Also the counterfactual still shows 23 binding lines and line 64-1501 flow 315.48 MW vs 312 MW limit in base, suggesting the 20% relaxation may not have been applied correctly.
